description: Boot to title screen on a clean install. Catches the B-324 class (NULL weapon pool at gun reset), B-318 class (walker emits zero rows on empty per-asset dirs), B-326 class (ROM at the wrong install path), and B-328 class (loader_pool head/body parser key-name mismatch -- the .pdhead/.pdbody emitter writes `mesh`/`hand` keys per the universality-pivot schema, so the parser must accept those same keys for the body/head pool to populate non-zero filenums and the master gun loader to reach LOADED).

input_sequence.comment: let boot run, no scripted input
boot smoke is log-based; exit before timeout when boot has settled

required_lines: LOADER\.UNIVERSAL\.OK: kind=weapon scanned=86 registered=86 envelope_failures=0 register_failures=0
LOADER\.UNIVERSAL\.OK: kind=head scanned=84 registered=84 envelope_failures=0 register_failures=0
LOADER\.UNIVERSAL\.OK: kind=body scanned=68 registered=68 envelope_failures=0 register_failures=0
